/login: Sign in to the Axiom console — local Basic auth, SSO (OIDC/SAML), or lab demo helper.
/getting-started: Live setup checklist — integration status and first tasks after sign-in.
/overview: Product home — hero, capacity, inventory, utilization; links into Alerts / Events / Logs.
/nodes: Kubernetes node inventory — Ready state, capacity, and entry into node detail.
/nodes/:name: Single-node conditions, capacity, taints, and related workloads.
/workloads: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets — scale, restart, seal, rollout, and Run workload wizard.
/workloads/:namespace/:kind/:name: Single controller — owned pods, events, labels, rollout, raw YAML.
/jobs: Batch Jobs and CronJobs — trigger runs, inspect status, delete.
/pods: Pod inventory across namespaces — phase, restarts, entry into pod detail.
/pods/:namespace/:name: Container specs, metrics, multi-tab PTY terminal, manifest Save, port Open.
/platform-intents: Intent-driven placement / platform requests surfaced in the console.
/networking: Service graph, NetworkPolicies, and live PacketWolf flows when configured.
/services: Kubernetes Service inventory and endpoints overview.
/ingresses: Ingress and Gateway API exposure inventory.
/namespaces: Namespace inventory — create and delete tenancy boundaries.
/vms: KubeVirt VM inventory and day-2 actions in the Axiom console.
/storage: PVC / storage class intelligence for the connected cluster.
/atlas: Atlas storage control-plane panel — backends, pools, volumes, buckets, policies.
/logs: Stream and inspect pod/container logs from the console.
/events: Kubernetes warning/normal events stream for triage.
/configmaps: ConfigMap inventory — create, edit keys, delete.
/secrets: Secret inventory — create typed secrets, add keys, delete.
/autoscaling: Horizontal Pod Autoscalers — create and delete.
/custom-resources: Browse CRD kinds and list custom resource instances.
/backups: Volume snapshots, Velero backups, and schedules.
/ops: Day-2 ops tabs — GitOps/Helm/RBAC/Identity and related operator tools.
/users: Local user accounts with admin or viewer roles.
/settings: Integrations, clusters, theme, and console configuration.
